newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cheung Kong trade error due to data input.
newsitem.headline: Cheung Kong trade error due to data input.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong said on Wednesday a data input error had caused a misquote of Cheung Kong (Holdings) Ltd shares on Tuesday.
Paul Phenix, head of compliance at the exchange, said the error occurred when a trader keyed in HK$56 for Cheung Kong shares instead of $65 as was originally intended.
"The error did not involve a great number of shares and was rectified shortly after," he said.
A low of HK$56.25 was registered for Cheung Kong shares in early trade on Tuesday before being changed to HK$60.00. Cheung Kong rose HK$0.50 to HK$65.00 in Wednesday morning trade.
